question: Ultraviolet (UV) radiation is capable of causing skin cancer, whereas Radio waves are not, despite both being electromagnetic. What is the fundamental physical reason for this difference?

options.A: Radio waves travel slower than UV rays and bounce off the skin.
options.B: The energy of a single photon of UV is high enough to break chemical bonds (DNA), unlike Radio photons.
options.C: Radio waves have a higher intensity than UV rays.
options.D: UV rays are particles, while Radio waves are pure waves.
